deploy-bot: [staged-rollout] start | env=production-us-east-1 | tag=v2.3.1-rc3 | commit=9f3b2a7 | percent=5%
maya: ack, monitoring dashboards up. running smoke + synthetic traffic for 10m :eyes:
alex: quick check — p95 latency target is 120ms, right?
julian: correct. also watch error-rate >0.5% as a red flag
deploy-bot: update | env=production-us-east-1 | tag=v2.3.1-rc3 | percent=5% | duration=3m | p95=115ms | error_rate=0.18% | avg_cpu_gpu=42%
maya: looks good so far. no new 5xx spikes in traces :thumbsup:
alex: I see a small uptick in tail latency for a single shard, digging into logs now.
sre-bot: synthetic-checker: anomaly=false | opq=steady | trace-sample=/traces/1830456175 | note=kv-cache-warmup
alex: found noisy host - log snippet:
```
2026-03-20T14:02:31Z ERROR model-serving: rpc timeout to runtime-7 (retrying)
2026-03-20T14:02:32Z WARN  runtime-7: slow init for kv cache (~2.3s)
```
julian: sounds like an outlier, probably a transient runtime GC. not enough to abort.
maya: we can continue to 25% if no regression in next 7m. promote window planned at +10m.
deploy-bot: update | percent=25% | duration=12m | p95=118ms | error_rate=0.22% | notes=one noisy host investigated
alex: after isolating runtime-7 to maintenance group, metrics normalized. p95 116ms now.
sre-bot: canary-metrics: p50=24ms p95=116ms p99=240ms errors=0.21% traffic_sample=3kreq/s
maya: decision: promote to 60% in 5m. tagging release notes draft and pinning artifact to v2.3.1-rc3.
julian: leaving a pin in infra: `image: registry.redwood/inference:v2.3.1-rc3` and rollout annotation.
deploy-bot: promote-in-progress | from=25% to=60% | env=production-us-east-1 | user=maya | command=`/deploy promote --to 60 --tag v2.3.1-rc3`
maya: executing promote now. watching logs and errors.
deploy-bot: success | promote-finish | to=60% | duration=45s | env=production-us-east-1 | tag=v2.3.1-rc3 | commit=9f3b2a7
alex: quick post-check — p95=119ms, error_rate=0.25% (within SLO), no new alerts
sre-bot: alerting-scan: none fired; retention traces captured for 2m window
maya: plan to keep at 60% for 30m, then go to 100% if stable. release notes updated: "improve kv-cache warmup and runtime kernel selection"
julian: noted, will coordinate changelog and rollback plan in case. rollback command: `/deploy rollback --tag v2.3.1-rc3 --to 0` saved in runbook
deploy-bot: scheduled-hold | at=+30m | action=auto-promote-to-100% if metrics stay within thresholds
maya: thanks team. I'll announce in #product after full promote. :tada:
